what: 3.5 How signal data reaches uPlot — DECIDED
title: ggm: Grammar of Electrograms — Design Blueprint
text: Worth stating plainly, dissolves natural worry: WFDB uPlot never touch. WFDB’s efficiency purely -disk (byte layout, seek reads). time data reaches uPlot already passed EGM’s reader R vectors serialized browser. Storage format renderer fully decoupled — -disk format (D-2: Parquet) zero effect uPlot, browser ever sees post-transform data. path favorable, two reasons: uPlot wants columnar input — one array per series + x array — signal_table/data.table already columnar (one column per channel). transform “list columns,” reshaping. pyramid means never ship full-res. Overview = thousand LTTB points; zoomed window = bounded (seconds × rate × channels). payloads small enough plain JSON transport fine. Binary transport (ArrayBuffers, Arrow--wire) needed try send raw full-res — pyramid means never . M0 actually validates serialization throughput (disk → columnar list → wire), “WFDB↔︎uPlot compatibility” — pairing doesn’t exist.

Verbs: - click empty → add - click near marker → select - drag → move (rewrites sample) - delete / right-click → remove - double-click / context menu → reclassify (type / subtype) uPlot.posToVal converts pixel → sample; hit-test within px. Build early: snap--peak. potentials sharp fast — clicking exact 1 ms sample maddening. Click roughly, snap local extremum (max |derivative|) within ±N ms. ~10 lines; turns correction fiddly fast. State pattern (Shiny): optimistic local update + R source truth. JS updates marker immediately (feels instant), fires Shiny.setInputValue, R updates reactiveVal holding working annotation_table pushes confirmed state back. Write-back — important, don’t overwrite place. Keep detector’s output immutable candidate annotator (<record>.); write human-corrected versions derived annotator (<record>.hisr). WFDB encodes provenance file extension, EGM::write_annotation(annotator = ...) gives free. Benefits: always diffable (algorithm vs corrected), corrections labeled ground truth later detector tuning. title: ggm: Grammar of Electrograms — Design Blueprint
text: Record every settled decision one-line rationale don’t reopen accident. Add new ones D-N. D-1 DECIDED — WFDB binary stays canonical; pyramid derived sidecar. Rationale: byte-seek reads beat columnar raw signal; overview gap, ’s regenerable. D-2 DECIDED — Pyramid storage Parquet, partitioned (channel, tier). Rationale: Arrow ecosystem + optional DuckDB queries coarse data + clean partitioning. Stores derived downsample tiers (+ manifest, + optional min/max envelopes), never raw .dat samples. Renderer- independent — uPlot never sees -disk format (§3.5). D-3 OPEN — Interactive UI: htmlwidget-first vs Shiny-module-first. Tradeoff: widget = usable standalone (RMarkdown, Quarto, plain R); module = faster path full app R state. 🔵 call. D-4 OPEN — Interval syntax grammar: indexed VA[1] vs span(V, ). D-5 DECIDED — Presentation layout single coordinate space (channels stacked vertical offset), faceted ggplot. Rationale: cross-channel arrows (V→) can’t drawn across facets even still; motivating VOP/SVT figure requires . D-6 DECIDED — print still terminal frame animation. One composition, exported vector timeline end. Rationale: eliminates whole class static-vs-animated mismatch; polished slide teaching reveal object. D-7 DECIDED — SVG + GSAP sole presentation engine. gganimate dropped — one job (data-state subplots) just another SVG element; faceted ggplot part presentation. Rationale: §5.0/§5.4 — facets can’t cross-panel marks; GSAP already timeline engine; one engine removes dependency two-renderers-must-match risk, keeping print-still = terminal-frame (D-6) airtight. (Supersedes earlier “gganimate demoted” form.) D-8 DECIDED — Sample index (integer) canonical key; time (seconds) display unit. Conversion via fs header exact; data-access API takes time, computes samples, returns . Rationale: exactness + clean joins .dat/annotations + WFDB-native, matching users think (). (§3.0) D-9 DECIDED — zoomed-overview two layers: faint signal (signal pyramid) + sharp event pyramid aggregates annotations (runs→spans, sparse→density bins, individual marks zoom-). Detectors populate (e.g. pacing-train) deferred arrive candidate annotators (<record>.train) — viewer changes needed. (§3.3b)
